stage.name: Three Meals a Day
stage.description:
Vanity is all that matters when you eat to be seen by others. Only you will ever know what the meal truly tastes like.
<Stove> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<Derelict Stove> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.

event.name: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion

content.label: OR
content.name: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion

expletive.name: Expletive
expletive.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a broken clay pot. The dinner table has always been a place for petty squabbles, and the clay pot is hardly the only thing that gets broken.
abilities: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Sapidity>

breakfast.name: Breakfast
breakfast.flavourText: Abomination born from the daily meals of the people. Breakfast is the first meal of the day, and thus should be hearty and plentiful. Drops Sapidity when defeated.
abilities: Spawns 1 <Sapidity> when defeated

profanity.name: Profanity
profanity.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a clay pot that broke someone's skull, itself undamaged. The dinner table has always been a place for squabbles. Tables are flipped and pots are broken, but in the end, everyone might still have to sit back down and eat together.
abilities: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Sapidity>

sapidity.name: Sapidity
sapidity.flavourText: Spirit born of the meals people cook every day. Everything picked up by the chopsticks—joy or sorrow, mirth or anger—is a slice of life.
abilities: Unblockable; Moves towards <Stoves> and can be absorbed by them, increasing their SP
Must be damaged 5 times to defeat; Spawns 1 <Vapidity> when defeated
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter; Automatically moves towards <Stoves>

vanity.name: 'Vanity'
vanity.flavourText: 'Put that one on my tab!' Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Often appears in drunken squabbles, but it is fragile and disappears easily.
abilities: Pulls 1 <Sapidity> within range towards itself, causing it to lose HP proportionate to distance moved when shifted

humility.name: 'Humility'
humility.flavourText: A drink reveals one's true nature and inspires deep conversations. Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Often appears in drunken squabbles, but usually disappears once one is sober.
abilities: Pulls 1 <Sapidity> within range towards itself, causing it to lose HP proportionate to distance moved when shifted

remembrance.name: Remembrance
remembrance.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally an elaborate water pot, it was not discarded even after its original purpose had become obsolete, being passed down through the family as a storage pot. Reach into this unusually deep vessel, and one can often find trinkets thought lost.
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield
Starts on standby
Can collect up to 1 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; On collection, activates and becomes aerial, moving towards <Derelict Stove>

sated.name: 'Sated'
sated.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a vessel for holding the five grains. The five grains are fundamental to sating hunger, and the vessel that stores them is appropriately solid and heavy.
abilities: More likely to be attacked

bloated.name: 'Bloated'
bloated.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a hardened vessel for holding the five grains. The five grains are fundamental to sating hunger, and the vessel that stores them must not only be solid and heavy, but also exceptionally tough.
abilities: More likely to be attacked

drifting_aroma.name: Drifting Aroma
drifting_aroma.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, add some burdenbeast tallow, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.
abilities: Continuously inflicts Arts damage and Burn to its surroundings
Immune to Slow

diet.name: 'Diet'
diet.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a chopsticks holder left to collect dust. The chopsticks are laid aside when food no longer has taste. Too tired to live, and too tired to die. Such laments summon Vapidity.
abilities: Periodically summons 1 <Vapidity>

boiling_pot.name: Boiling Pot
boiling_pot.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.
abilities: Continuously inflicts Arts damage and Burn to its surroundings
Immune to Slow

fasting.name: 'Fasting'
fasting.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a chopsticks holder left to collect dust for a century. The chopsticks are laid aside when food no longer has taste. Abhorring life and abhorring death, such loud laments summon Vapidity.
abilities: Periodically summons 1 <Vapidity>

forethought.name: Forethought
forethought.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Life is always easier when there is spare meat and grain in the kitchen. Those who have known hardship always keep something in stock for a rainy day.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Can collect up to 4 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; when full, moves towards <Derelict Stoves>
When defeated, spawns <Vapidity> equal to amount collected

sureness.name: Sureness
sureness.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Life is always easier when there is spare meat and grain in the kitchen. Those who have known hardship are not above stealing to keep a stock of food.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Can collect up to 4 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; when full, moves towards <Derelict Stoves>
When defeated, spawns <Vapidity> equal to amount collected

wealth.name: Wealth
wealth.flavourText: Abomination born of the people's longing for a better life. Approach it carelessly, and copper coins will come at you in a way that you did not bargain for.
abilities: Spits copper coins to deal heavy damage at long range; Uses only melee attacks when out of coins
Can absorb nearby <Vapidity> or <Sapidity> to regain 1 copper coin

sapid_auspice.name: 'Sapid Auspice'
sapid_auspice.flavourText: Abomination born of a convergence of Sapidity. Likes to hover over places where many gather, an auspicious symbol that drives out illness and keeps disaster away.
abilities: Deals True damage to all enemy units in its path
Cannot be attacked, does not count towards the defeated enemies counter, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field

vapid_blight.name: 'Vapid Blight'
vapid_blight.flavourText: Abomination born of a convergence of Vapidity. Likes to hover over places that are barren and broken, a symbol of misfortune.
abilities: Deals True damage to all allied units in its path
Cannot be attacked, does not count towards the defeated enemies counter, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field
